mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files(id, path, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{id}, #{path}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_images pi JOIN products p ON p.id = pi.product_id WHERE pi.file_id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variants pv JOIN products p ON p.id = pv.product_id WHERE pv.image_file_id = #{id} AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brands b WHERE b.file_id = #{id} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brands b WHERE b.file_size_id = #{id} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM landing_banners lb WHERE lb.file_id = #{id} AND lb.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collections c WHERE c.file_id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_posts bp WHERE bp.cover_file_id = #{id} AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) + CASE WHEN #{path} IS NULL OR #{path} = '' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.description_html IS NOT NULL AND POSITION(CONCAT('/files/', #{path}) IN p.description_html) > 0), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collections c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.description_html IS NOT NULL AND POSITION(CONCAT('/files/', #{path}) IN c.description_html) > 0), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_posts bp WHERE bp.deleted_at IS NULL AND bp.content_html IS NOT NULL AND POSITION(CONCAT('/files/', #{path}) IN bp.content_html) > 0), 0) END

SELECT f.id, f.path, f.status, f.created_at FROM files f WHERE f.status = 'INACTIVE' AND f.created_at < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.image_file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM landing_banners lb WHERE lb.file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collections c WHERE c.file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_posts bp WHERE bp.cover_file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brands b WHERE b.file_id = f.id OR b.file_size_id = f.id)
